name: Designed for Distinction – MailPoet Opt-in for Formidable Forms
author: Designed for Distinction

sections.description:
MailPoet Opt-in for Formidable Forms is a simple, WordPress-native connector that adds subscribers to MailPoet when a Formidable form is submitted.

  • Works with Formidable Forms (Free or Paid).
  • Requires the MailPoet plugin to be installed and active.
  • Does not require Formidable’s MailPoet add-on.
  • Does not use third-party services.

This plugin is intentionally scoped to opt-in subscriptions. It respects MailPoet subscription rules and does not force re-subscription of previously unsubscribed addresses.

Features

  • Form → MailPoet list connections (“rules”)
  • Explicit opt-in checkbox support
  • Optional “Always subscribe” mode per rule (use when your form has no opt-in field)
  • One list per rule
  • Compatible with MailPoet double opt-in workflows
  • Admin-only AJAX field mapping
  • Clean uninstall (removes plugin settings)

Requirements

  • Formidable Forms (free or paid)
  • MailPoet plugin (active)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure MailPoet and Formidable Forms are installed and active.
  4. Go to Settings → Formidable → MailPoet Opt-in.
  5. Add a rule:
    • Form ID
    • MailPoet List ID
    • Email Field
    • Opt-in mode (Field or Always)
    • Subscriber status (Subscribed or Unconfirmed)
sections.faq:
Does this work with Formidable Free?

Yes. This plugin works with the free or paid version of Formidable Forms.

Do I need the Formidable MailPoet add-on?

No. This plugin connects directly to MailPoet using MailPoet’s API.

Why is a subscriber showing as unconfirmed or unsubscribed?

If MailPoet is configured to require confirmation (double opt-in), new subscribers may be marked as unconfirmed until they confirm. This plugin also does not force re-subscription for addresses that previously unsubscribed.

What if my form does not have an opt-in checkbox?

In each rule, choose Always subscribe. Use this only when you have consent handled elsewhere.
